coaching_note: Back from ~3.5 weeks off (Italy — some biking incl. Vesuvius, no lifting). RETURN WEEK: all loads cut ~10%, RIR 2–3, zero PR chasing — back to your pre-trip loads next week if pain-free. Tendons lose load tolerance faster than strength over a layoff, so ease the eccentric leg curl and RDL especially. Wins from the pre-trip block that stuck: a6 in the warmup and the step-down reorder both got done, and you PR'd (pulldown 120, leg press 90, ham curl 50, face pull 60). Two fixes this week: (1) TKE is swapped for the Short-Arc Quad (a11) — same VMO/terminal-extension work but on a bench with an ankle weight, no band-on-a-post needed; please actually do it (2 sets). (2) Thursday was running long and its ski/lateral work got skipped, so it's trimmed and re-ordered — lateral step-ups and band walks come right after the power block now. Aim every session at 50–75 min; the Optional block is only if you're under time.

a5.note: Lead LEFT every set. Hold 20 — and actually FINISH all sets (logged incomplete your last two Lower A's).

a6.note: Warmup activation — medium band, 2x15, hips stacked, toes forward. Keep doing it here; it's finally sticking.

a7.note: Down from 40 (the KB single) for the return week. BRACE first — left low-back. Back to 40 next week if clean.

a8.note: Down from 50 for the return week. 3-sec eccentric. Back to 50 next week if clean. Stay on the machine for a10.

a9.note: Down from 45. Start left leg, squeeze to lock at the top. Pair with a7 (same DBs + bench).

a10.note: Eccentric leg curl (accentuated) — down from 80 for the return week. Lift with both legs, lower slow with ONE (3–4 sec). Ease the eccentric back in — this detrains fastest. Back toward 80 next week.

a11.note: NEW — Short-Arc Quad replaces the band TKE (no post needed). Sit on a bench, knee bent over a rolled towel/foam roller, straighten to full lockout, 2-sec hold, slow down. Add an ankle weight or loop a light DB over your foot. (Machine alt: leg-extension top-third only, 2-sec hold.) 2 sets — please DO them; the old TKE got skipped every session.

a12.note: 3x8/side, 4-sec lower, knee over the 2nd toe. You nailed these last time — keep it. Box/bench area with a11 + a13.

a13.note: 3-sec slow lower. Add the 25 back if a machine/step with load is free (was bodyweight last time).

b4.note: Down from your 120x12 PR for the return week. → back to 120 next week. Alternate at the pull machines with b5.

b5.note: Lead LEFT — it fatigues first. Down slightly for the return week.

b6.note: ELBOWS OUT (rear-delt row). You settled at 32.5x12 clean — hold it. Bench + DBs, pair with b9.

b7.note: Down from your 60 PR for the return week. 2-sec hold at the ears. → 60 next week. Cable rack with b8.

b8.note: Down slightly for the return week. Overhead range, then the lat stretch (b10) after. Cable rack with b7.

b9.note: Brace the core. Left was harder last time — match it. Same DBs as b6.

c5.note: Down from your 90x10 PR for the return week. 3-sec eccentric, at/under 90deg, lead left. Phase II gate lift — back to 90 next week.

c6.note: OPTIONAL now (quads are covered by c5 + the goblet squat, and the SAQ hits the VMO on Monday). Do it if you're under time. 2-sec hold, lead left.

c7.note: 18in box, 4-sec lower. Kill the left-knee wobble. Same box as e9 — do them back to back.

c11.note: OPTIONAL now — Monday's kickstand RDL already covers the posterior chain. Do it if you're under time. Big-toe-side pressure, soft knees.

e4.note: Goblet Squat, tempo contrast 4x6. Hold the 25 baseline you set. 4-sec down, EXPLODE up, pain-free depth. DBs/KB — pair with e5.

e5.note: DB Deadlift, tempo contrast 4x5, 25/arm. 3-sec lower, explosive hip snap. Same DBs as e4.

e7.note: Lateral Band Walk + Squat, yellow band, 3x10/side. MOVED EARLIER so it stops getting skipped — most ski-specific pattern in the program. Toes forward, full tripod.

e8.note: Single-Leg Balance Reach, 2x5 reaches each direction/side. LEFT leg priority. Close eyes if easy.

e9.note: Lateral Step-Up, 4-6in box, 3x8/side. MOVED EARLIER (right after the power block). Push through the working leg, slow lower. Ski-turn force production. Same box as c7.

e11.note: Copenhagen Plank (modified, bottom knee down), 3x20s/side. Quick core finisher.

d4.note: Down from 32.5 for the return week. Do it FIRST, fresh. Stop the set at ANY tendon signal. Bench + DBs, pair with d7.

d5.note: CABLE fly, 35/arm. Pec-fly machine is a fine sub but DON'T log it as the cable PR (your note). Cable rack cluster.

d6.note: 2 sets, feet elevated on the same bench as d4/d7.

d7.note: Fix the LEFT shrug — long neck, lead the elbow. Same DBs as d4.

d8.note: Converging machine, NEUTRAL grip only (tendon-protective). DBs made you arch — machine is primary, DB seated only if it's taken.

d9.note: Lead LEFT, match reps right to left. Cable rack cluster.

d10.note: Pain-free — but this is the return week, so hold 45. Cable rack cluster.

d11.note: First real test on the new program — light CABLE (constant tension), 3x12. Stop at the FIRST tendon signal and hit the Skipped/Pain flag if it twinges. Cable rack cluster, last.
